video_summary.overall_goal: Add a podcast (Up First from NPR) to subscription list in AntennaPod podcast manager
video_summary.description: User opens AntennaPod podcast app from home screen, navigates to 'Add podcast' feature, searches for podcast via Apple Podcasts catalog, finds 'Up First from NPR', views podcast details, and subscribes to it. The workflow includes app launch, navigation to podcast discovery, search/selection from suggestions, viewing episode details, and subscribing to add the podcast to user's subscription list.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Android home screen with app launcher grid displaying installed apps including Finder, DuckDuckGo, AntennaPod (podcast icon), Port Authority, Simple Notes, WiFiAnalyzer, Lux Alarm, Mobdist, Jigsaw, Pomomdoer, AdAway, and others. System status bar at top.
steps.navigation_change: Android Home Screen → AntennaPod Main Activity

steps.what_screen_is_visible: AntennaPod main screen showing empty or default state. Bottom navigation tabs visible: Home (selected), Queue, Inbox, Subscriptions, More. Screen appears mostly blank suggesting no podcasts subscribed yet or loading state.
visible_ui_elements: Navigation tabs (Home, Queue, Inbox, Subscriptions, More)
steps.visual_feedback: Tab changes to Subscriptions, view updates

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Add podcast discovery screen with header 'Add podcast'. Search field labeled 'Search podcast...'. Grid of podcast suggestion tiles (gray placeholders) showing 12 available podcast suggestions. Button 'Show suggestions' visible. Links below: 'Add podcast by RSS address', 'Add local folder', and 'Suggestions by Apple Podcasts' with 'Discover more' link. Bottom navigation visible.
steps.visual_feedback: Text input field becomes active, search text entered

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Add podcast screen with search field showing user query being typed. Sidebar menu visible on left with icons: microphone, X (clear), search (highlighted/selected), smiley, hamburger menu. Shows 'Type a query to search' prompt in center when search is active.
visible_ui_elements: Left sidebar menu with action icons
Search prompt text 'Type a query to search'
steps.system_response: Search completes, results from Apple Podcasts appear
steps.navigation_change: Search results populate on current view
steps.visual_feedback: Podcast search results appear, grid updates with relevant matches
steps.intent_task: Wait for search to complete and display results

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Add podcast discovery screen showing list of options: 'Add podcast by RSS address', 'Add local folder', 'Search Apple Podcasts', 'Search fyyd', 'Search Podcast Index', 'Import podcast list (OPML)'. User is browsing available podcast addition methods. Sidebar menu visible.
visible_ui_elements: Search options (Apple Podcasts, fyyd, Podcast Index)
steps.system_response: Navigation to Apple Podcasts search interface
steps.navigation_change: Add Podcast Screen → Apple Podcasts Search View

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Podcast search results showing 'Up First from NPR' as featured result. Podcast thumbnail shows blue and yellow 'Up First' logo. Podcast title and network 'NPR' displayed. Blue 'Subscribe' button visible. Description and episode preview section below showing recent episodes with dates (Feb 19, Feb 17) and titles. User not yet subscribed ('You are not subscribed to this podcast yet...' notice displayed).
visible_ui_elements: Episode previews with dates and durations
steps.system_response: Podcast subscription initiated, podcast added to subscription list
steps.navigation_change: Subscribes to podcast, returns to subscriptions or confirmation
steps.visual_feedback: Subscribe button changes state or success confirmation appears
steps.intent_task: Subscribe to 'Up First from NPR' podcast

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Podcast detail view showing 'Up First from NPR' with subscription confirmed. Modal or overlay visible with 'Add podcast' header and back arrow. Podcast details including description text about the podcast ('US & Iran Plan To Meet Again, CBS: Colbert & Cooper, Social Media On Trial'), episode list, and subscription status updated. 'APPLY' button visible at bottom (red circle with white plus and 'APPLY' text). View shows podcast is now in user's subscription list.
visible_ui_elements: Podcast detail header with back navigation
steps.system_response: Subscription is finalized and saved, returns to main subscription list
steps.navigation_change: Closes detail view, returns to subscriptions or main view
steps.visual_feedback: Modal closes or view transitions back to subscriptions list

overall_flow: Access Add Podcast discovery screen with search and options
Tap on search field and enter podcast search query
Access search options and select Apple Podcasts search
Search returns results, find 'Up First from NPR' podcast
View podcast details and press Subscribe button
Confirmation is applied and saved to subscription list
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: User taps AntennaPod app icon from home screen, app opens showing main activity
Step 2: User navigates from Home tab to Subscriptions to access podcast management features
Step 3: User taps on search field in Add Podcast screen and begins typing podcast name 'Up First from NPR'
Step 4: User continues searching and system shows search options with sidebar menu for search refinement
Step 5: User selects 'Search Apple Podcasts' from available search provider options to find podcast from Apple's catalog
Step 6: Search returns 'Up First from NPR' podcast as featured result; user views podcast description, recent episodes, and taps blue Subscribe button
Step 7: Subscription to 'Up First from NPR' is finalized and confirmed; user presses APPLY button to complete the action and add podcast to subscription list
